items.title: TeamViewer Flaw Could Let Malicious Hosts Take Over Support Technicians’ Machines
items.description: An integer overflow tracked as CVE-2026-111585 could be used to execute arbitrary code on the viewer’s system. The post TeamViewer Flaw Could Let Malicious Hosts Take Over Support Technicians’ Machines appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency has warned that attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-97229. This GitLab vulnerability could allow code execution without logging in. CISA added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 29, 2026, confirming evidence of active exploitation and raising the urgency for organizations running affected GitLab servers. items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure 0-Days Exploited in the Wild to Gain Unauthenticated Root Access
items.description: Attackers are chaining zero-day flaws in Ivanti Connect Secure VPN appliances to gain unauthenticated root access, exposing stored credentials and sensitive Active Directory data. Ivanti confirmed attacks against a limited number of customers and released additional fixes on October 29, 2026, following its initial October patches. Volexity tracked UTA0576 activity to October 3 and, during […]…

items.title: Microsoft Fixes Remote Desktop Connection Failures Following Recent Updates
items.description: Microsoft resolved a Windows 11 issue that blocked non-admin users from connecting via Remote Desktop when Administrator protection was enabled, releasing fixes on October 28, 2026, for connection failures with error 0xC000000D. The bug appeared after the September 22 non-security preview update, KB5124010, or later updates. Affected users could see the message, “The token that […] The post…

items.description: A security researcher got Claude AI to hand over an internal Anthropic program and a memory dump that held pieces of a working Google Cloud token. The findings were published on October 29, 2026. They show how a helpful chatbot can expose the systems that run it. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-118539 (CVSS score: N/A), is a case of missing authorization affecting Commerce Core versions from 0.0.0 to 2.41 and from 3.0.0 to 3.3.13. items.description: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3 billion worth of assets. The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange said nearly $3 billion of those assets have been frozen on-chain so far. items.description: Prediction market platform Polymarket temporarily suspended trading on Thursday after hackers compromised a third-party service to distribute cryptocurrency-draining JavaScript, with approximately $2.5 million in assets traced to a suspected attacker wallet. [...]

items.title: Claude Model Builds Exploits Across Major Browsers & OSes

items.title: When Risk Becomes Personal: What Security Leaders Can Learn From a Cancer Diagnosis
items.description: Risk managers are trained to spot weak signals, plan for disruption and make hard decisions under uncertainty. But the discipline looks different when the risk is not a system or an enterprise, but you. The post When Risk Becomes Personal: What Security Leaders Can Learn From a Cancer Diagnosis appeared first on SecurityWeek.
